displayTitle: The Ultimate Star Wars Episode I Sticker Book
synopsis: The Ultimate Star Wars Episode I Sticker Book is an 8-page book filled with four additional pages of stickers of heroes, villains, spacecraft, vehicles, droids, and equipment from Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace. It was originally published by DK in 1999 and additionally offered as part of the Star Wars Episode I: Limited Edition Gift Pack. Learn about Star Wars: Episode I with this fun and informative sticker book. Choose the stickers to create your own book of Star Wars: Episode I. Easy-peel stickers can be used more than once.
title: The Ultimate Star Wars Episode I Sticker Book
